captions.story: We found life thriving where it should be completely impossible.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of the Tonga Trench?
story.summary: This episode explores the extreme depths of the Tonga Trench, revealing how translucent snailfish survive crushing pressures and how whale calls echo down into the abyss.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of the Tonga Trench?
